_source: OSRIC 3.0 Player's Guide — the per-class 'Higher-Level Abilities' sections (§1.3.2.3 cleric, §1.3.4.3 fighter, §1.3.6.3 magic-user, §1.3.10.3 thief) and the NOTES column of each class level-advancement table.
_note: Concise summaries; the full rules text lives in docs/OSRIC_Player_Guide.md. In OSRIC these abilities are gained automatically on reaching the listed level (there is no chosen-feat mechanic). Only the four engine-supported classes are encoded here; assassin, druid, illusionist, monk, paladin and ranger have their own Higher-Level Abilities sections in the docs and can be added in this same shape.

fighter.name: Heroic Assault
fighter.summary: Act on segment 1 regardless of initiative and make one attack per fighter level against enemies too weak to have rolled 8+ hp on their Hit Dice; replaces your normal attack / Melee Attack Combination that round.

fighter.name: Melee Attack Combination (3/2)
fighter.summary: 3 melee attacks over 2 rounds (attack in segments 1 and 10 on the odd round). Non-specialised weapons only; improves to 2/1 with a specialised weapon.

fighter.name: Mighty Blow
fighter.summary: When your to-hit bonuses drive the number you need below zero, add that overage as a bonus to your damage roll.

fighter.name: Stronghold and Title
fighter.summary: May build a stronghold and attract followers.

fighter.name: Melee Attack Combination (2/1)
fighter.summary: 2 melee attacks per round (segments 1 and 10). Non-specialised weapons only; improves to 5/2 with a specialised weapon.

cleric.name: Divine Craft
cleric.summary: Craft holy water, certain potions (including healing and extra-healing) and clerical scrolls of spells you can cast — never for monetary profit.

cleric.name: High Priest / Priestess
cleric.summary: May establish a temple and attract followers.

cleric.name: Divine Power
cleric.summary: May attempt to create certain permanent magic items (GM-gated by religion; success never guaranteed).

magic-user.name: Eldritch Craft
magic-user.summary: Brew potions, scribe arcane scrolls of spells you know, and recharge aimed magic items (rods, staves, wands) — recharging risks destroying the item.

magic-user.name: Eldritch Power
magic-user.summary: With enchant an item known, may attempt to create magic items (GM-gated; success never guaranteed).

thief.name: Establish Guild
thief.summary: May establish a guild or stronghold in a town or city.

thief.name: Read Scrolls
thief.summary: May attempt to cast from an arcane, phantasmal or druidic scroll: roll 1d4 (1 = the casting fails, scroll survives); a cast spell has a 5% chance of a reversed or harmful effect.
